description: MODA: open fashion retrieval benchmark and models by Hopit AI. MODA (203M, open source), MODA Pro Lite (213M, open weights), MODA Pro (hosted). Full-corpus benchmarks vs FashionSigLIP, SigLIP-SO400M and ZooClaw — one harness, losses shown. #1 open model on LookBench.
